summary: Two women, ages 67 and 70, lost while hiking in search of pinon trees near Zapata Falls; one called her husband saying they were lost and scared, with no gear for the impending weather or an overnight stay. AVSAR callout sent at 1645, team en route; deputies waiting at the Zapata Subdivision and the falls parking area; the women were located safe at 1744 and AVSAR stood down.
